scope: same final binary, actual app direct outbound chain with UDPResolveReuse true in both modes; loopback IP targets, fixed verified payload; actual CLI JSON logging and Docker json-file driver; no Internet or production test traffic
metrics_boundaries: server/harness CPU are separate process RUSAGE_SELF deltas. Cgroup combines both; Docker logging daemon CPU is outside. Metrics include post-transfer 100ms logging grace; throughput excludes grace. Handshake/warmup and outer connection shutdown lie outside transfer measurements. memory.peak is cumulative container peak, not reset each run.
